_note: Recorded from the GitHub API on 2026-09-24 by a live dry run of watch/discover.mjs (3 search pages, 40 repositories checked), then cut down to one search page of the repositories below. Kept fields are the ones discover.mjs reads.

Commit messages keep the subject line and agent Co-Authored-By trailer lines only, emails replaced by noreply@redacted.invalid; READMEs keep a window around the agent statement (or the first 1200 characters). The builder checked that every trimmed repository gives the same signals as its full recorded responses.

Synthetic: example-fork-owner/ai-memory is a copy of akitaonrails/ai-memory marked fork: true, with the same signal responses, so a broken fork exclusion lists it. Dicklesworthstone/franken_ocr's signal responses were fetched separately (the live sweep excludes it by owner) for the same reason.

issues: the repository's issue list as the selftest's in-memory store starts it: one suggest-a-project issue naming alphaXiv/OpenResearch, and one watch issue (not labelled candidate) naming h4ckf0r0day/obscura, which must stay listed. discover-prior-2026-W38.json is an earlier week listing kvcache-ai/AgentENV.
